test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The five-year plan focuses mostly on private intervention in the economy.
The five-year plan always focused on the growth of the tertiary sector.
The five-year plan permits long-term intervention by the government in the economy.
A five-year plan always stresses market-oriented activities.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Five-Year Plans are strategic frameworks used by the government to guide the economy's development over a fixed period (typically five years).
 
• In India, these plans were implemented by the Planning Commission (replaced by NITI Aayog in 2015).
 
• Focus on Developmental Goals:
 
 
• Poverty Alleviation: Plans aimed at reducing poverty through employment generation schemes, rural development, and welfare programs.
 
 
 
• For instance, the Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980–1985) emphasized poverty reduction.
 
 
• Industrialization: Plans like the Second Five-Year Plan (1956–1961), which focused on heavy industries, laid the foundation for India's industrial base.
 
• Agriculture: Plans like the First Five-Year Plan (1951–1956) concentrated on increasing agricultural productivity.
 
• Infrastructure Development: Several plans prioritized building physical and social infrastructure, including power, transportation, education, and healthcare.​
 
 
 
• Hence statement 3 is correct
